Shield Trigger
■ Destroy one of your opponent's creature that has power 7000 or less.
■ Add one of your shields to your hand. You can't use that "shield trigger" ability.

■ 自分のシールドを1つ、手札に加える。ただし、その「S・トリガー」は使えない。
